page.overview:
Who is Kieran?

Kieran is a character first appearing in . He is a Pokémon Trainer, the younger brother of Carmine and a student attending Blueberry Academy.

In The Teal Mask, Kieran is seen wearing a Traditional White Jinbei outfit. Instead of wearing a mask of the Loyal Three, he wears the Ogre mask.

In The Indigo Disk, Kieran wears a red sleeveless shirt and a white coat and is seen with the bangs of his hair pulled back except for a single strand. He claims that by pulling his hair back, he would be able to perform better in Pokémon battles.

Kieran is a quiet boy with a gentle nature who often hides behind his older sister, Carmine. He looks up to the player character, admiring them as someone cool and strong, and despite his timid demeanor, he harbors a deep desire to grow stronger. Unlike most people, Kieran sympathizes with Ogerpon and prefers her over the Loyal Three, recognizing her strength despite being alone. As the story progresses, he becomes increasingly jealous of the player for forming a bond with Ogerpon and ultimately capturing her. Notably, the French version of the game confirms that Kieran is 14 years old, while the Spanish version adds that he is going through puberty—something Carmine suspects is behind his shifting emotions and behavior.
